description: This file defines a PHP class 'GeoZone' within the Opencart framework, responsible for retrieving geo zone data from the database. It includes methods to get a specific geo zone by IDs and to retrieve all geo zones.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: A model class in the Opencart framework for managing geo zone data, including fetching individual geo zone info and lists of geo zones.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone record based on geo zone ID, country ID, and zone ID from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves all geo zone records from the database, ordered by name.
